_readme: One job = one video, for one or more platforms. Paths are relative to THIS file. Keys starting with _ are comments. Values inside platforms.<name> override the top-level values for that platform.
title: Your video title
caption: Your post text, without hashtags.

youtube.description: Your description. {{VIDEO_ID}} is replaced with the real video id after upload.

facebook._说明: 通过 Meta Business Suite 发主页 Reels。page_name 填你的主页名，用来核对没发错主页；composer_url 留空 = Business Suite 首页。

instagram._说明: format: reel（发 video）或 carousel（发 images，1-10 张）。网页版不能定时，schedule 必须留空。

linkedin._说明: 只发文字帖，video / images 会被忽略。正文可以比短视频文案写长一些。
linkedin.caption: A longer post text for LinkedIn. Hashtags from tags are added at the end.

x._说明: attach_video=false 则不带视频；max_chars 默认 280（中日韩字符算 2）。
